class.name: EditorExportPlatformUWP
class.description: Exports the project as an [code].appx[/code] package for the HoloLens 2 (UWP, arm64): the template's [code]godot.exe[/code], the project as [code]godot.pck[/code] beside it, any shared objects export plugins add (the C# NativeAOT library) and the command line in [code]__cl__.cl[/code]. The package is signed with [code]signtool[/code] from the Windows SDK, found by itself unless [code]export/uwp/signtool[/code] is set in the Editor Settings, using the certificate in [member signing/certificate]; its subject must be [member package/publisher]. Installing the package on a device also needs its certificate trusted there and the arm64 [code]Microsoft.VCLibs[/code] framework.

members.member: Package architecture. Only [code]arm64[/code], the HoloLens 2, is built.
[code]bluetooth[/code] device capability.
[code]gazeInput[/code] device capability: eye tracking.
Outgoing network access. On by default.
Incoming network access, needed to listen on a socket. On by default.
[code]location[/code] device capability.
[code]microphone[/code] device capability.
Access to the local network.
[code]spatialPerception[/code] capability: spatial mapping on the HoloLens.
[code]webcam[/code] device capability.
Command line arguments passed to the exported project, space separated.
Path to a custom debug template zip, instead of [code]uwp_arm64_debug.zip[/code] from the export templates.
Path to a custom release template zip, instead of [code]uwp_arm64_release.zip[/code] from the export templates.
Tile background color: [code]transparent[/code] or [code]#rrggbb[/code].
Splash screen, a 620x300 PNG. Empty keeps the template's.
App list logo, a 44x44 PNG. Empty keeps the template's.
Tile logo, a 150x150 PNG. Empty keeps the template's.
Store logo, a 50x50 PNG. Empty keeps the template's.
Application description.
Application display name. Empty uses [member ProjectSettings.application/config/name].
Package publisher, the subject of the signing certificate ([code]CN=...[/code]). Required.
Publisher display name. Required.
Package identity name, 3 to 50 letters, digits, dots and dashes ([code]Company.GameName[/code]). Required.

Path to the signing certificate ([code].pfx[/code]). Empty leaves the package unsigned, which no device installs. Can be overridden by the [code]GODOT_UWP_SIGNING_CERTIFICATE[/code] environment variable.
Password of the signing certificate. Can be overridden by the [code]GODOT_UWP_SIGNING_PASSWORD[/code] environment variable.
If [code]true[/code], project textures are exported in the ETC2/ASTC format.
If [code]true[/code], project textures are exported in the S3TC/BPTC format, which the HoloLens 2's D3D12 driver reads.
